title: Season entry accepts impossible league-points totals above the league maximum
steps: Use a normal season in a 20-team league, whose double round-robin maximum is 114 league points.
Enter league position 1, league points 115 and a normal non-negative goals total for one manager; enter valid values for the other manager.
The local season-entry validator accepts 115 because it only checks that league points are a non-negative whole number.
The same 115-point result is rejected by shared season-results and canonical scoring because both calculate maxPoints as (teamCount - 1) * 2 * 3.
expected: Season result entry should reject league points above the maximum possible for the selected league before review and saving.
actual: The normal season-entry path accepts and can save an impossible league-points total, while the shared result and canonical scoring paths reject it.
root_cause: getSeasonEntryValidationMessage validates league points only as a non-negative integer and does not apply the team-count-based maxPoints rule already used by the shared season-results and canonical-scoring modules.

fix.change: After obtaining the selected league team count, calculate maxPoints = (teamCount - 1) * 2 * 3 and reject league points above that value before creating the season review.

assumptions: The selected leagues use a standard double round-robin league schedule, matching the formula already treated as authoritative by the shared validation and scoring code.
Chat checks do not create Node repro scripts, so this finding is marked likely rather than confirmed.
